name: tv-guide
description: Stash channel management with Jellyfin IPTV and an optional Stashy adapter

scripts.sync: test -n "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR" || (echo 'Error: STASH_PLUGIN_DIR not set' && exit 1) && npm run build && rm -rf "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR" && mkdir -p "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR" && cp tvguide.js tvguide.css tvguide-server.js TVGuide.yml IPTV.md NATIVE-APPS.md THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt tvguide-iptv.service "$STASH_PLUGIN_DIR/"
